content.comment_body: Hello! Is it possible to turn the background lighting of the display on or off directly from the [product_name] system? I found references to this issue, but has it been resolved in the latest [article_no]? Regards, [user_name]

Yes, it's possible. Set Flag M25 to ON, and the backlight will turn ON. Flag M26 is used for the light on the operator display. To learn more about setting a Flag, right-click on the flag to view its info.

Hello [user_name], If you activate the background lighting incorrectly, I'm not sure your [product_name] will remain functional. Background lighting is also activated using Flag M25 on a [article_no]. Kind regards, [user_name]

Hi, Yes, you can control the lighting for both displays. However, this changes the normal behavior—normally, the backlight toggles on/off automatically about every 40 seconds when a cursor button is pressed. Best regards, [user_name]
You can also set the [product_name] backlight to remain always on. In the setup menu, choose LCD and then BackLight to change the setting to always on.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are discussing options to control the background lighting of a display integrated into [product_name] via software flags and device settings. While it's possible to keep the backlight always on, doing so overrides the default feature where the light turns off after inactivity. There is some uncertainty about the consequences of changing these settings, but users provide practical instructions and alternatives.
analysis.user_expectations: The user seeks a way to enable or disable the display’s background lighting directly through [product_name] logic, asking for confirmation if this option is available in newer hardware versions.
